# Import decomposition fixtures

`table-merged.dwg` is an 8.6 KB synthetic ACadSharp 3.8.0 DWG, generated by
`generate-table.cs.txt`. It contains a 2 by 2 TABLE with a merged first row,
insertion point (100, 200), rotation 30 degrees, scale (2, 3), and one LINE.
The table has no cached display geometry, so it exercises cell reconstruction.
Expected decomposition: one INSERT, with 11 boundary LINEs and 3 MTEXTs;
the independent model-space LINE also exercises split-lines verification.

To regenerate, copy the generator to `Program.cs` in a temporary .NET 8 console
project inside this workspace, reference `dwg-runtime/ACadSharp.dll`, and pass
the desired DWG output path as its sole argument. Registering CodePages is
required by ACadSharp and is included in the generator. Keep .NET CLI home,
NuGet caches and TEMP/TMP inside the workspace; set
`DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE=false` before the first SDK invocation.

REGION tests generate small SAT/SAB DXFs with ezdxf. ACadSharp 3.8.0 cannot write
REGION into either DXF or DWG, so it cannot generate a truthful REGION DWG
fixture; its SAT/SAB metadata handoff is tested through its DXF reader instead.
